children: Overview
UK cleaning products maker's preliminary full-yr revenue rose 0.8% amid inflationary pressures
Profits declined yr/yr as Q4 margin recovery lagged following Middle East crisis
Company completed Eurotab acquisition and announced Vestacy partnership, both expected to boost future growth
Outlook
Company expects first-quarter margin lag, with improvement during second quarter, subject to materials pricing
Cost environment remains difficult to predict; further price rises increasingly likely due to geopolitical tensions
Volumes in early new financial year in line with expectations; some regions show early signs of stronger growth
Result Drivers
INPUT COSTS - Geopolitical tensions in the Middle East led to higher raw material and logistics costs, impacting margins in Q4
PRICE RECOVERY LAG - Timing lag between input cost increases and price implementation concentrated margin impact in Q4
PRIVATE LABEL DEMAND - Marginal growth in private label volumes helped offset weaker contract manufacturing demand
